Resource Broker Service (RBS) HTTP API.

System

RbsCore::system — service identity and API/build version via GET /rbs/version (system metadata). Does not require authentication.

Get service name, API version, and build metadata

Return the service name, API contract version, and build metadata (version, git hash, build time). No authentication required.

Authorizations:
None

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/version

Response samples

  • 200
Content type
application/json
{
  • "service_name": "globaltrustauthority-rbs",
  • "api_version": "0",
  • "build": {
    • "version": "0.1.0",
    • "git_hash": "",
    • "build_date": ""
    }
}

Admin

User management CRUD — GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rbs/v0/users (admin or self). Requires BearerToken.

List users (admin only)

List users with pagination and optional role / enabled filters, ordered by username. Requires an enabled admin Bearer token.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
limit
integer <int64> [ 1 .. 100 ]

Page size (1..100, default 10).

offset
integer <int64> [ 0 .. 100000 ]

Offset (0..100000, default 0).

role
string (Role)
Enum: "admin" "user"

Filter by role (admin or user).

enabled
boolean

Filter by enabled status.

Responses

Create a user (admin only)

Create a user with authentication key material. Only the user role can be assigned here — the admin role is pre-configured and rejected (400). Exactly one of public_key / jwk is required (they are mutually exclusive). username is immutable after creation; 409 when it already exists or the configured max_users quota is reached.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

New user record: username, optional role/enabled, auth type, and exactly one of public_key or jwk.

username
required
string [ 1 .. 36 ] characters ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$

Login or unique handle. Immutable.

null or Role (string)
enabled
boolean or null

Whether the account is enabled.

auth_type
required
string (AuthType)
Value: "jwt"

Authentication method; currently only jwt is supported.

public_key
string or null

Base64-encoded PEM public key (mutually exclusive with jwk).

jwk
any

JWK public key JSON object (mutually exclusive with public_key).

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/users

Update a user (admin or self)

Update a user; at least one field is required and username itself is immutable (path parameter only). Non-admin self-updates may only change key material (public_key / jwk) and auth_type — a changed role or enabled: false is rejected with 403. The admin role is not API-assignable, and the built-in Administrator's role / enabled cannot be changed.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
username
required
string

Username

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Fields to update; at least one required. public_key and jwk are mutually exclusive.

null or Role (string)
enabled
boolean or null

Whether the account can authenticate.

A non-admin self-update may set this to true (a no-op) but may not disable itself; false is rejected with self-update may not modify 'enabled' (403).

null or AuthType (string)
public_key
string or null

Base64-encoded PEM public key (mutually exclusive with jwk).

jwk
any

JWK public key JSON object (mutually exclusive with public_key).

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/users/{username}

Policy

Policy CRUD — GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rbs/v0/resource/policy. Requires BearerToken.

List policies

List the caller's own policies with optional ids filter and pagination; policies are user-scoped and other users' policies are never returned. When ids is present, only those are returned and pagination is ignored.

offset
integer <int64> [ 0 .. 100000 ]

Create a policy

Create a policy owned by the caller. content must be base64-encoded Rego that decodes to valid UTF-8 within the configured size limit; the name must be unique per user. 409 on duplicate name or when the per-user policy quota is reached.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Policy name, content encoding (base64), and base64-encoded Rego content.

name
required
string [ 1 .. 255 ] characters ^[^<>"'&|\\/*?`]*$

Policy name, unique per user (1-255 chars; the characters < > " ' & | \ / * ? and ` are forbidden).

content_type
required
string^base64$

Encoding of content; only base64 is supported.

content
required
string non-empty

Base64-encoded Rego policy text; must decode to valid UTF-8 within the configured size limit.

Replace a policy (name, content_type, and content are all required — full replacement, not a patch). The version increments on every update; a concurrent update loses the race and fails with 409 (optimistic locking). User-scoped: 403 when owned by another user.

Resource

Resource CRUD — GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /rbs/v0/{provider}/{repo}/{type}/{name}. Supports AttestToken and BearerToken.

List the caller's resources

List all resources owned by the calling user (resource details by user dimension), newest first, with pagination. Metadata only — secret content stays on the per-resource GET and POST .../retrieve paths (JWE). Bearer token only (Attest tokens carry no user subject); the list is strictly user-scoped and other users' resources are never returned.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
limit
integer <int64> [ 1 .. 100 ]

Page size (1..100, default 10).

offset

Get resource content

Read resource content with owner Bearer or attest token authorization; the bound Rego policy is evaluated and hsm/ca content requires an attest token. The content is always JWE-encrypted to the caller's key (enc-pubkey Bearer claim or tee-pubkey attest claim) and base64-encoded. Missing and denied reads are collapsed into the same 404.

Authorizations:
bearerAuthattestAuth
path Parameters
res_provider
required
string

Backend provider name; must be configured under resource.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. vault, ca, hsm); reserved names (admin, attestation, resource, health) are rejected

repository_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$

Repository name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _ and -)

resource_type
required
string

Resource type; must be in the provider's configured allowed_resource_types (e.g. secret, cert, key)

resource_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$

Resource name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _, - and .)

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

Update or create resource

Upsert a resource owned by the caller. Omitted optional fields keep their current values; an explicit policy_id rebinds the resource (must be caller-owned) while omitting it keeps the current binding — a new resource created via this path requires policy_id. Returns 201 when created, 200 when updated, and 409 on a concurrent update (optimistic locking).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
res_provider
required
string

Backend provider name; must be configured under resource.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. vault, ca, hsm); reserved names (admin, attestation, resource, health) are rejected

repository_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$

Repository name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _ and -)

resource_type
required
string

Resource type; must be in the provider's configured allowed_resource_types (e.g. secret, cert, key)

resource_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$

Resource name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _, - and .)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Fields to change; omitted optional fields keep their current values. policy_id is required when the upsert creates a new resource.

policy_id
string or null [ 1 .. 36 ] characters

New policy binding (must be caller-owned); omitted keeps the current binding. Required when the upsert creates a new resource.

content_type
string or null

New content type label (jwt, json, text, binary, jwk, jwe); omitted keeps the current value.

export_mode
string or null

New export mode; only jwe is accepted; omitted keeps the current value.

additional_info
string or null

New description (when present, 1-512 chars); omitted keeps the current value.

content
string or null

Base64-encoded replacement content; omitted leaves the backend content unchanged.

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/{res_provider}/{repository_name}/{resource_type}/{resource_name}

Create resource

Register a resource owned by the caller. policy_id must reference one of the caller's policies and governs reads of this resource. content (base64) is stored via the backend when it supports PUT; for CHECK backends the object must already exist; metadata-only backends (e.g. CA) need no content. 409 on duplicate URI or per-user resource quota.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
res_provider
required
string

Backend provider name; must be configured under resource.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. vault, ca, hsm); reserved names (admin, attestation, resource, health) are rejected

repository_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$

Repository name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _ and -)

resource_type
required
string

Resource type; must be in the provider's configured allowed_resource_types (e.g. secret, cert, key)

resource_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$

Resource name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _, - and .)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Policy binding (required) plus optional content_type, export_mode, additional_info, and base64-encoded content.

policy_id
required
string [ 1 .. 36 ] characters

UUID of the caller-owned policy that governs reads of this resource.

content_type
string or null

Content type label; one of jwt, json, text, binary, jwk, jwe (fixed whitelist).

export_mode
string or null

Export mode on read; only jwe is accepted (plaintext export is rejected); defaults to jwe.

additional_info
string or null

Free-form description of the resource; when present, 1-512 chars (empty string rejected).

content
string or null

Base64-encoded content, stored via the backend when it supports PUT. Optional for backends that generate the object themselves (e.g. CA) or require it to pre-exist.

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/{res_provider}/{repository_name}/{resource_type}/{resource_name}

Retrieve resource with attestation evidence

The client submits RBC evidences in the request body.

The service calls the configured attestation backend to verify the evidence and obtain an attest token, then uses the token claims (including tee-pubkey) for Rego policy evaluation and JWE encryption of the resource content.

Authorizations:
None
path Parameters
res_provider
required
string

Backend provider name; must be configured under resource.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. vault, ca, hsm); reserved names (admin, attestation, resource, health) are rejected

repository_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$

Repository name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _ and -)

resource_type
required
string

Resource type; must be in the provider's configured allowed_resource_types (e.g. secret, cert, key)

resource_name
required
string [ 1 .. 32 ] characters ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$

Resource name (1-32 chars; only letters, digits, _, - and .)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Evidence bundle (same shape as POST /rbs/v0/attest) including the nonce from GET /rbs/v0/challenge; the token's tee-pubkey claim is used to JWE-encrypt the returned content.

as_provider
string or null

Optional attestation backend id (e.g. gta); default is deployment-specific.

object (RbcEvidencesPayload)

Evidence bundle from RBC.

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/{res_provider}/{repository_name}/{resource_type}/{resource_name}/retrieve

Attestation

Attestation challenge/token issuance (GET /rbs/v0/challenge, POST /rbs/v0/attest, no auth) and attestation management CRUD for ref_value/cert/policy (/rbs/v0/attestation/{as_provider}/{type}, Bearer + admin only).

Submit attestation evidence and obtain token

Submit the RBC evidence bundle to the attestation backend; on success an attest token is returned for resource reads (GET .../{resource} and POST .../retrieve). The token is replayable until it expires. rbc_evidences.measurements[].nonce_type supports only verifier (the verifier-generated challenge from GET /rbs/v0/challenge); attester-generated nonces are not supported. No authentication required.

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json
required

Evidence bundle including the nonce obtained from GET /rbs/v0/challenge (nonce_type must be verifier); attester_data.runtime_data.tee-pubkey (JWK) is used to JWE-encrypt returned resources.

as_provider
string or null

Optional attestation backend id (e.g. gta); default is deployment-specific.

object (RbcEvidencesPayload)

Evidence bundle from RBC.

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

Update a certificate

Update a certificate/CRL record identified by in-body id; all other fields are optional pass-through. GTA rejects content changes on update. Admin Bearer only; RBS proxies to GTA (503 when unreachable, other GTA statuses forwarded as-is).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
as_provider
required
string

Attestation provider name; must be configured under attestation.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. gta)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

ID of the certificate to update plus optional new field values; content changes are rejected by GTA.

id
required
string

ID of the certificate to update (1-32 chars, GTA-enforced).

name
string or null

New name (1-255 chars).

description
string or null

New description (at most 512 chars).

type
Array of strings or null

New certificate type list (JSON field name type); 1-7 items, each one of refvalue, policy, tpm_boot, tpm, tpm_ima, ascend_npu — crl cannot be set on update.

content
string or null

Certificate content — GTA rejects this on update.

is_default
boolean or null

Whether to set as default certificate.

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/attestation/{as_provider}/cert

Create a certificate

Create a certificate or CRL record: when type contains crl, crl_content is required; otherwise content is required. Admin Bearer only; RBS proxies to GTA (503 when unreachable, other GTA statuses forwarded as-is).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
as_provider
required
string

Attestation provider name; must be configured under attestation.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. gta)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Certificate or CRL record: when type contains crl, crl_content is required; otherwise content is required.

name
required
string non-empty

Certificate name (1-255 chars, GTA-enforced).

type
required
Array of strings

Certificate type list (JSON field name type); 1-7 items, each one of refvalue, policy, tpm_boot, tpm, tpm_ima, crl, ascend_npu; crl must be the only entry.

description
string or null

content
string or null

crl_content
string or null

is_default
boolean or null

Whether to set as default certificate.

Create an attestation policy

Create a GTA attestation policy: name, attester_type (non-empty list), content_type (jwt or text), and content are required. Admin Bearer only; RBS proxies to GTA (503 when unreachable, other GTA statuses forwarded as-is).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
as_provider
required
string

Attestation provider name; must be configured under attestation.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. gta)

Request Body schema: application/json
required

Policy definition: name, attester type list, content encoding (jwt or text), and content.

name
required
string non-empty

Policy name (1-255 chars; GTA rejects the special characters < > " ' & | \ / * ? and `).

attester_type
required
Array of strings non-empty

Attester type list (1-9 items, each at most 255 chars); supported values: all, tpm, tpm_boot, tpm_ima, virt_cca, ascend_npu, itrustee, cca, dice.

content_type
required
string non-empty

Content encoding (required): jwt or text (GTA-enforced).

content
required
string non-empty

Policy content (base64-encoded); the decoded size is bounded by GTA's policy_content_size_limit (shipped default 500 KB).

is_default
boolean or null

Whether to set as default policy.

description
string or null

Optional description (at most 512 chars).

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/attestation/{as_provider}/policy

Get a single reference value baseline

Fetch one reference value baseline by ID (full record). Admin Bearer only; RBS proxies to GTA (503 when unreachable, other GTA statuses forwarded as-is).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
as_provider
required
string

Attestation provider name; must be configured under attestation.backends in rbs.yaml (e.g. gta)

id
required
string

Ref_value ID (1-36 chars, GTA-enforced)

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/attestation/{as_provider}/ref_value/{id}

Obtain an attestation challenge (nonce)

Obtain a one-time attestation challenge (nonce) from the attestation backend (GTA). Echo the nonce verbatim in rbc_evidences.measurements[].nonce when calling POST /rbs/v0/attest or POST .../retrieve. No authentication required.

Authorizations:
None
query Parameters
as_provider
string

Target provider ID for challenge

Responses

Default local development (see rbs.yaml rest.listen_addr)

http://127.0.0.1:6666/rbs/v0/challenge
